This chapter collects reference material: pointers to the templates, policies, and forms appendices; a glossary of terms; a resource list; and acknowledgments.

## Appendix A — Templates

Reusable, fill-in templates live in [templates](/templates). See the [Templates appendix](../templates/index.qmd). They include:

- New Member Onboarding Checklist

- Individual Development Plan (IDP)
- Student Research Plan
- Manuscript Planning Sheet
- Authorship / Contributorship Agreement
- Data-Use and Access Checklist
- GitHub Repository Checklist
- Reproducible Analysis Checklist
- AI-Use Disclosure Form
- Conference Abstract Planning Sheet
- Weekly Meeting Agenda
- One-on-One Mentoring Meeting Template
- Stop / Start / Continue Feedback Form
- Offboarding Checklist

Authoritative policy documents live in `/policies`. See the [Policies appendix](../policies/index.qmd):

## Appendix D — Glossary

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Through-line** | Exposure Science → Immune Bioactivity → Computational Forecasting → Equity-Focused Translation → Inclusive Workforce Development |
| **Community-to-Clinic-to-Cloud** | Our central narrative: measure environmental signals in communities → link to clinical/claims/biomarker outcomes → convert to equity-aware decision tools |
| **Pod** | A small, project-specific team with defined roles |
| **IDP** | Individual Development Plan |
| **IAP** | Individual Academic Plan (the PI's strategic roadmap) |
| **DUA** | Data Use Agreement |
| **ICMJE** | International Committee of Medical Journal Editors (authorship criteria) |
| **CRediT** | Contributor Roles Taxonomy |
| **CITI** | Collaborative Institutional Training Initiative (research-ethics training) |
| **Educational Biomarker Discovery Lab (EBDL)** | The branch through which RIPLRT research is conducted within Lynn University |
| **IRB** | Institutional Review Board |
| **Felix E. Rivera-Mariani, PhD, LLC** | The parent legal entity (FL #L21000280781; PR #467494) under which the RIPLRT Institute operates |
| **Lynn University** | Institutional home of the EBDL and of Lynn-affiliated members |
| **RespRisk** | The group's respiratory-risk forecasting/decision-support workflow line |
| **RIPLRT Institute** | The research group as a whole, including all members and projects, operating under the LLC. |
| **EBDL** | An interdisciplinary research entity being formalized within the institutional framework *(placeholder — confirm scope/name)* |
| **SMART goals** | Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound goals (12/36/60-month) |
| **University of Puerto Rico (UPR)** | Collaborating institution; home institution of UPR-affiliated mentees, who remain governed by UPR policy and IRB. |

## Appendix E — Key resources and platforms

- **Code & versioning:** GitHub (Git), GitHub Projects
- **Project management:** ClickUp
- **Documents:** Google Drive / OneDrive
- **Analysis & reporting:** R/RStudio, Python, Quarto / R Markdown
- **Structured data capture:** Qualtrics, REDCap *(if applicable)*
- **Open science / archiving:** OSF, Zenodo, FigShare
- **Datasets & repositories:** Departments of Health claims & pharmacy; fungal-spore aeroallergen stations; BioLINCC; BioData Catalyst; *All of Us* Workbench; MESA; Framingham; AsthmaNet; NHANES, among others
- **Methods:** AI/ML, distributed lag models, mixed-effects models, GWAS, polygenic risk scores, SHAP explainability, causal mediation, multi-agent AI; equity-stratified analysis, among others

## Appendix F — Acknowledgments

This 2026 manual builds on the 2018/2021 RIPLRT Lab Manual and the members, alumni, and writing mentors who created and maintained it. It was inspired by the open lab-manual movement and the broader community of research groups who share their handbooks so others can learn. We thank every RIPLRT member — past and present — who has contributed to making this group both a serious scientific program and a humane place to grow.
